description: This file is a Node.js script that monitors file system changes using chokidar and manages a child process to run or restart a specified node script ('scripts/run-node.mjs'). It contains logic for path normalization, watching paths, and handling process signals for clean shutdowns and restarts.

methods.name: buildRunnerArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for running the Node.js child process based on input arguments.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes file path strings by replacing backslashes with forward slashes and removing leading './'.

methods.name: resolveRepoPath
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes a file path relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isIgnoredWatchPath
methods.description: Determines if a watched file path should be ignored based on whether it is relevant for restart.

methods.name: runWatchMain
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up file system watching and manages the child process for running or restarting the watched script.
